player_change: Android free-action play now exposes the same destination choice as desktop when the current World has multiple locations.

The selected destination is sent through the shared narrative command boundary as a Python-validated move command before narrate; the Android UI no longer silently loses location changes that desktop submits.
Runs without multiple locations keep the simpler free-action input and do not invent a destination control.
not_proven: The rebuilt APK cannot be installed for physical Android A-F because adb devices is empty.
Windows and macOS packaged visual journeys remain unproven.
